entities.name: Bifunctional Nnr enzyme
observations: The 669-residue query protein contains Pfam YjeF_N (PF03853.22; residues 35–236) and Carb_kinase (PF01256.23; residues 292–554) domains.
Swiss-Prot homologs P9WF10, P9WF11, and P37391 show 30.7–32.5% identity, 73.8–75.6% query coverage, and highly significant E-values (3.4e-34 to 3.7e-41).
Homologs are annotated as bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzymes catalyzing NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration.
The inferred biological process is metabolite repair, specifically nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process.
Curated homologs report one bound K+ per subunit; this cofactor assignment is inferred for the query by homology, not experimentally established.
Functional evidence is limited homology support rather than direct characterization of this exact sequence.

entities.name: NAD(P)H metabolite repair
observations: Nnr repairs hydrated NADH and NADPH intermediates, NAD(P)HX, by epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration back to NAD(P)H or NAD(P)H-related products.
Associated GO processes in curated homologs are metabolite repair (GO:0110051) and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolic process (GO:0046496).

entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair reactions
observations: Curated homologs support (6R)-NAD(P)HX = (6S)-NAD(P)HX epimerization and (6S)-NAD(P)HX + ADP = AMP + phosphate + NAD(P)H + H+ dehydration reactions.
Associated EC numbers are 5.1.99.6 for NAD(P)HX epimerase activity and 4.2.1.136 for ADP-dependent NAD(P)H-hydrate dehydratase activity.
